name: Gateway Plaza
summary: Gateway Plaza is a community shopping center in Tracy, California, offering convenient daily shopping from 8 AM to 10 PM. With a 4.2-star rating and accessible amenities, it serves as a practical retail destination for local residents seeking everyday services and retail options.
demographics: Gateway Plaza serves the Tracy, California community, attracting primarily middle-income families and working professionals from the Central Valley region. The trade area draws from Tracy's diverse population with a median household income typical of suburban California communities, including young families with children and commuters working in the Bay Area. Shoppers tend to prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday necessities and services in a single location. The center's accessibility features and practical tenant mix appeal to a broad demographic base focused on routine shopping needs rather than luxury or entertainment-focused visits.
description: Gateway Plaza is a community shopping center conveniently located at 1900 West 11th Street in Tracy, California, serving as a practical retail destination for local residents and visitors. The center operates daily from 8 AM to 10 PM, providing extended hours for shoppers seeking convenience throughout the week. With a solid 4.2-star rating from 489 Google reviews, Gateway Plaza has established itself as a reliable shopping option in the Tracy area. The center features wheelchair accessible entrances and offers in-store shopping experiences across its various retail and service tenants. Positioned in the growing Central Valley community of Tracy, Gateway Plaza provides essential retail services and amenities to meet the everyday needs of its diverse customer base.
